definitions.explanation: The government ministry in charge of the national budget, taxation, government debt and currency. It replaced the old {大蔵省|おおくらしょう} in 2001.

examples.japanese: {財務省|ざいむしょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{予算|よさん}{案|あん}→予算案：09761_yosanan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦まとめた→まとめる：02424_matomeru⟧。
examples.english: The Ministry of Finance put together the draft budget.

examples.japanese: {財務省|ざいむしょう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{国|くに}→国：02204_kuni⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{予算|よさん}→予算：03663_yosan⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{税制|ぜいせい}→税制：28854_zeisei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{担当|たんとう}→担当：02567_tantou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The Ministry of Finance is in charge of the national budget and the tax system.

examples.japanese: {財務省|ざいむしょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{発表|はっぴょう}→発表：03562_happyou⟧⟦によると→〜によると：03104_niyoruto⟧、⟦{国|くに}→国：02204_kuni⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{借金|しゃっきん}→借金：03203_shakkin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{過去|かこ}→過去：00152_kako⟧⟦{最大|さいだい}→最大：04827_saidai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{更新|こうしん}した→更新する：27994_koushinsuru⟧。
examples.english: According to the Ministry of Finance, the national debt has hit a new record.

notes:
CULTURAL NOTE:
Created in 2001 from the old {大蔵省|おおくらしょう} (also translated "Ministry of Finance"), which older texts still mention. The National Tax Agency ({国税庁|こくぜいちょう}) is part of it.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{財務|ざいむ}→財務：05971_zaimu⟧⟦{大臣|だいじん}→大臣：03417_daijin⟧: Minister of Finance
- {財務省|ざいむしょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{発表|はっぴょう}→発表：03562_happyou⟧: an announcement by the Ministry of Finance
- {財務省|ざいむしょう}{主計局|しゅけいきょく}: the ministry's Budget Bureau
